products.description: Enjoy the pure taste of Milk Penda, a soft and delicious traditional Indian sweet. Slow-cooked to a smooth, fudge-like texture and lightly flavoured with cardamom, it brings gentle sweetness to everyday treats and special occasions. Each batch is made with a simple combination of milk, sugar, and cardamom.

A traditional choice for festivals and prasad

products.priceNote: Ask us to confirm the pack size and current price.
products.mainImageAlt: Golden Special Mava Penda flavoured with nutmeg and cardamom
products.description: Special Mava Penda is a rich, traditional Indian sweet made from pure mava, or slow-cooked milk solids. Nutmeg and cardamom add a warm aroma, while balanced sweetness lets the creamy taste of milk and spices come through. Its soft texture makes it a lovely dessert for everyday moments, festivals, and family celebrations.
highlights: Made with mava, slow-cooked milk solids
Warmly flavoured with nutmeg and cardamom
Balanced sweetness with a soft, creamy texture
A thoughtful sweet for festivals and prasad
products.storage: Keep in a cool, dry place. Avoid warm areas to maintain its texture.
